changes.title: Canopy pool
items: Flying over the treetops, the witch's light warms the crowns under her instead of turning them bright green

changes.title: Pond rims
items: The small ponds in the bog and the other wet places read as water now, not dark holes: a moonlit far shore, the sky's sheen, a muddy lip and the odd glint

changes.title: Legend circle music
items: Step into a sleeping legend's clearing on the ground and the music goes muffled while the legend's own mysterious music rises over it, different for every kind of legend
